stem: Based on the excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, how did the Chinese Exclusion Act affect the U.S. economy?

options.label: A
options.text: Companies lobbied to be able to hire non-Chinese workers.

options.label: B
options.text: Some industries criticized the loss of Chinese workers.

options.label: C
options.text: Some industries had a reduced desire to impose tariffs on Chinese goods.

options.label: D
options.text: Companies were prohibited from trading Chinese goods.

visual_elements: One of the big questions which is agitating this country at the present time is the Chinese exclusion act and the effect its rigid enforcement has . . . on American commerce. . . . The cry for more liberal immigration laws for the Chinese comes wholly from the manufacturers. —"The Chinese Exclusion Act," The Bisbee Daily Review, June 30, 1905
